The text matters: without it the guard cannot tell a real extraction from a line that both surfaces replaced with DIFFERENT text. The look-alike sets matter: they are the hashes of the lines that ALREADY resembled this one when the baseline was written, and without them the guard reads one of those as a `replacement` and fails a plain mirrored deletion. `-` means none.
